description: DAL-agtig INSERT + ordre for DAL Demo.

assertions.sql: SELECT name, city, email FROM customers WHERE name = 'DAL Demo'

SELECT c.name AS kunde, p.name AS produkt, o.quantity, o.order_date::text FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE c.name = 'DAL Demo' ORDER BY o.order_date
assertions.message: Del 2+3: ordre på Espresso via JOIN
